notes.title: Gundroid Batch Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44062212/d7cbb37bca9c8986ee8aec4554a43edf00a1d7ee.jpg"]



Hello everyone,



i am really happy that Gundroid finally released and for all the postive feedback and reviews. Thank you so much!

I got a lot of feedback from players and from looking at gameplay, i am currently working on several improvements for the game:

Fixing bugs

Improving Boss behaviours and adding some new attacks

Balancing issues

Multiplayer Couch co-op

Achievements



It will take some time but i am planning to make seperate updates. Multiplayer needs the most work but i am on it!



Thank you again and stay tuned!
